actions.description: Test full API contract and restart durability
actions.command:
set -e
# Post a new job, then restart worker mid-flight simulation: post a job, immediately restart worker
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "POST new: %{http_code}\n" -X POST --data-binary 'hello-world' http://127.0.0.1:8080/jobs/test-001
sleep 0.3
echo "--- GET test-001 ---"
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8080/jobs/test-001; echo

# Restart worker to prove durability
systemctl restart queue-worker.service
sleep 1
echo "--- after worker restart ---"
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8080/jobs/test-001; echo

# Restart api too
systemctl restart queue-api.service
sleep 1
curl -s -w "\nhealth: %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:8080/health
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8080/jobs/accepted-alpha-7d3; echo

# UTF-8 payload test…
